messages:
anya: Heads up — I’m seeing ~12 accounts where the health score toggled Healthy <-> At Risk within a 10m window after onboarding events. All from the onboarding-playbook. Suspect the playbook webhook is firing twice for the same state change.
marcus: I saw similar logs. The HubSpot connector returned a 429 and the retry logic fired, but we also got a duplicate event delivered to the playbook API. Repro in staging.
julie: A few of those accounts are on the same segment (mid-market). We had an outreach scheduled so this flipped status caused double-touch alerts in the CSM queue. Not ideal.
playbook-bot: Triggered playbook: onboarding-health for acct_acme123 at 2026-03-20T17:24:02Z (received)
playbook-bot: Triggered playbook: onboarding-health for acct_acme123 at 2026-03-20T17:24:18Z (received)
samir: Root cause looks like two paths: connector retry + no idempotency key in the playbook trigger API. We should make the trigger idempotent by event_id header and also add a short debounce window in the health-calculator.
kevin: Agreed. Quick proposal: require Idempotency-Key header (event_id) on /playbooks/v1/trigger and have the API persist last 24h keys with a simple dedupe check. Also add a 30s debounce in the health score worker for the same account+playbook.
samir: Implementation notes: persist event_id in Redis set with TTL 24h, atomic check+set. If duplicate, return 200 with "already_processed". Also update connector retry to use exponential backoff and include the original event_id in retries.
kevin: Example request we should support:
```
POST /playbooks/v1/trigger
Headers:
  Idempotency-Key: evt_01HabcXYZ
Payload:
{
  "event_id": "evt_01HabcXYZ",
  "account_id": "acct_acme123",
  "playbook": "onboarding-health",
  "state": "at_risk",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T17:24:00Z"
}
```
marcus: For rollout, recommend: 1) staging validation with HubSpot sandbox, 2) enable idempotency in a feature-flag for 10% of events, 3) monitor duplicate rate and errors, 4) full rollout after 48h stability.
julie: Also need a short CS playbook note to avoid panic: CSMs should ignore duplicate queue items with same account+timestamp +/- 1m until we push fix. I can add a banner to the CSM queue UI.
ops-automation: Scheduled backfill job created: backfill/remove-duplicate-triggers-2026-03-21 at 02:00 UTC — will dedupe historical duplicate events for last 7 days and regenerate health scores where changes occurred.
anya: Action items:
- [ ] kevin: implement Idempotency-Key handling + Redis dedupe (ETA: end of day tomorrow)
- [ ] samir: connector retry patch + exponential backoff (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- [ ] marcus: run staging validation and enable FF for 10% (ETA: after kevin deploys)
- [ ] julie: post CSM note and temporary filter to hide suspected duplicates (ETA: today afternoon)
- [ ] ops-automation: run backfill job and report changed accounts (scheduled)
anya: If we want extra safety we can add a short-lived "last_playbook_state" cookie in the account record to ignore immediate replays within 30s. But Idempotency-Key is the source of truth.
kevin: I'll open the PR now and drop the link here.
kevin: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/playbooks/pulls/482 — includes Redis dedupe helper and unit tests.
marcus: I'll coordinate canary once PR is merged. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for the rollout notes and linkouts. Will update after backfill completes.
